# FireMD

> FireMD is a collaborative Markdown notes app (React + Firestore) with a CLI and an MCP
> server so that an AI agent can read and edit the user's notes. Firestore security rules
> apply to the agent exactly as they do to a person: there are no service keys and no
> bypass. The CLI returns plain text, never JSON.

## For agents

- [Full CLI and MCP guide](https://firemd.app/agent.md): login, every command, permissions
  and exit codes. **Start here.**
- The CLI ships with FireMD. It is not on a public registry yet and the source repository is
  private while the product is in beta, so the guide documents the contract rather than a
  clone command.

## The minimum

1. Sign in: `firemd login` (opens the browser with the user's account).
2. Read: `firemd ls`, `firemd cat <id>`.
3. Edit: `firemd patch <id> --etag <etag> --find <text> --replace <text>`.

## MCP server

`firemd-mcp` exposes seven text tools: `notes_list`, `notes_read`, `notes_patch`,
`notes_append`, `notes_search`, `notes_create`, `folders_list`. It shares the CLI's
credentials.

## Pricing and quota

- Free daily quota, renewed at 00:00 UTC: 100 MB of storage and 700 operations per day.
- Prepaid balance, bought in packs of USD 1, 5 and 20, up to USD 100 per purchase. Unused
  credit expires 24 months after purchase and has no cash value.
- Charged per unit only for usage above the free quota: writes $0.50, reads $0.30 and
  deletes $0.10 per 100,000 operations, storage $0.60 per GB-month, transfer $0.20 per GB,
  agent operations $0.50 per 100,000. Admin accounts do not pay.
- Card payments are handled by Polar, the merchant of record, which also handles sales tax
  and VAT at checkout. There is no subscription: you add credit and it is spent on usage.
- [Pricing](https://firemd.app/pricing): the full per-unit tariff, the packs, the free tier
  and the FAQ.
